title: Secrets of the Red-Haired
summary: Ye Fan finishes the Huangjin elder with the Eight Prohibitions. He then deals with Jin Chixiao, who set him up twice, and takes the Huangjin family's Earth Milk to purify the Biluo Bell. He leaves Pang Bo to research the ancient star path at the Qishi Academy and reaches Dragon Transformation 4th level. Following records of the Cai clan, who were said to hold one of the Nine Secrets until the Azure Emperor wiped them out with one finger, he finds their ruins. There a Heaven Source seal holds the remnant soul of King Biluo. Biluo tells him that the red-haired monster who imprisoned him was a Heaven Source Master. Ye Fan frees Biluo and returns his bell. In return Biluo says that two Cai disciples stole the Weapon Secret and fled to the Cixing Mountains, then fades away, grieving for the family he left behind to chase immortality. In the Cixing Mountains, echoes of the past show the Cai ancestor, who had outlived his lifespan, coming back with red hair.
